mapper.select: SELECT agent_version_id AS version_id, version_no, readiness, last_update_time FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_version WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT t.tool_id, t.tool_code, t.tool_name, t.display_alias, t.tool_type, t.status AS tool_status, t.latest_version_id AS tool_version_id, t.latest_version_no AS version_no, t.latest_readiness AS readiness, tv.exposed_name, tv.description, tv.read_only, tv.mcp_server_id, ms.latest_version_id AS mcp_server_version_id, ms.server_name AS mcp_server_name, ms.status AS mcp_server_status, ms.latest_readiness AS mcp_server_readiness, ( t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status = 'ENABLED' AND t.latest_readiness = 'READY' AND ( t.tool_type != 'MCP' OR (ms.mcp_server_id IS NOT NULL AND ms.deleted_at IS NULL AND ms.status = 'ENABLED' AND ms.latest_readiness = 'READY') ) ) AS usable, CASE WHEN t.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN '工具已删除' WHEN t.status != 'ENABLED' THEN '工具已停用' WHEN t.latest_readiness != 'READY' THEN '工具配置未就绪' WHEN t.tool_type = 'MCP' AND (ms.mcp_server_id IS NULL OR ms.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) THEN '关联 MCP 已删除' WHEN t.tool_type = 'MCP' AND ms.status != 'ENABLED' THEN '关联 MCP 已停用' WHEN t.tool_type = 'MCP' AND ms.latest_readiness != 'READY' THEN '关联 MCP 配置未就绪' ELSE NULL END AS unusable_reason FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_version_tool b JOIN squad_chat.sq_tool t ON t.tool_id = b.tool_id LEFT JOIN squad_chat.sq_tool_version tv ON tv.tool_version_id = t.latest_version_id LEFT JOIN squad_chat.sq_mcp_server ms ON ms.mcp_server_id = tv.mcp_server_id WHERE b.agent_version_id = #{agentVersionId} ORDER BY b.sort_no ASC, b.id ASC

SELECT t.tool_id, t.tool_code, t.tool_name, t.display_alias, t.tool_type, t.status AS tool_status, t.latest_version_id AS tool_version_id, t.latest_version_no AS version_no, t.latest_readiness AS readiness, tv.exposed_name, tv.description, tv.read_only, tv.mcp_server_id, ms.latest_version_id AS mcp_server_version_id, ms.server_name AS mcp_server_name, ms.status AS mcp_server_status, ms.latest_readiness AS mcp_server_readiness, ( t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status = 'ENABLED' AND t.latest_readiness = 'READY' AND ( t.tool_type != 'MCP' OR (ms.mcp_server_id IS NOT NULL AND ms.deleted_at IS NULL AND ms.status = 'ENABLED' AND ms.latest_readiness = 'READY') ) ) AS usable, CASE WHEN t.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN '工具已删除' WHEN t.status != 'ENABLED' THEN '工具已停用' WHEN t.latest_readiness != 'READY' THEN '工具配置未就绪' WHEN t.tool_type = 'MCP' AND (ms.mcp_server_id IS NULL OR ms.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) THEN '关联 MCP 已删除' WHEN t.tool_type = 'MCP' AND ms.status != 'ENABLED' THEN '关联 MCP 已停用' WHEN t.tool_type = 'MCP' AND ms.latest_readiness != 'READY' THEN '关联 MCP 配置未就绪' ELSE NULL END AS unusable_reason FROM squad_chat.sq_tool t LEFT JOIN squad_chat.sq_tool_version tv ON tv.tool_version_id = t.latest_version_id LEFT JOIN squad_chat.sq_mcp_server ms ON ms.mcp_server_id = tv.mcp_server_id WHERE t.tool_id IN
#{id}

SELECT sub.agent_id AS subagent_id, sub.agent_code AS subagent_code, sub.agent_name AS subagent_name, sub.display_alias AS subagent_display_alias, sub.agent_type AS subagent_type, sub.status AS subagent_status, sub.latest_version_id AS subagent_version_id, sub.latest_version_no AS version_no, sub.latest_readiness AS readiness, d.delegation_name, d.delegation_description, d.display_alias, COALESCE(sv.description, '') AS subagent_description, ( SELECT count(*) FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_version_tool b WHERE b.agent_version_id = sub.latest_version_id ) AS tool_count, ( sub.deleted_at IS NULL AND sub.agent_type = 'SUB_AGENT' AND sub.status = 'ENABLED' AND sub.latest_readiness = 'READY' ) AS usable, CASE WHEN sub.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN '子 Agent 已删除' WHEN sub.agent_type != 'SUB_AGENT' THEN '目标不是子 Agent' WHEN sub.status != 'ENABLED' THEN '子 Agent 已停用' WHEN sub.latest_readiness != 'READY' THEN '子 Agent 配置未就绪' ELSE NULL END AS unusable_reason FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_version_subagent d JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent sub ON sub.agent_id = d.subagent_id LEFT JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version sv ON sv.agent_version_id = sub.latest_version_id WHERE d.master_version_id = #{agentVersionId} ORDER BY d.sort_no ASC, d.id ASC

#{id}

SELECT a.agent_id, a.agent_code, a.agent_name, a.display_alias, a.latest_version_id, a.latest_version_no, COALESCE(v.description, '') AS description, ( SELECT count(*) FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_version_tool b WHERE b.agent_version_id = a.latest_version_id ) AS tool_count FROM squad_chat.sq_agent a JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version v ON v.agent_version_id = a.latest_version_id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.agent_type = 'SUB_AGENT' AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND a.latest_readiness = 'READY' ORDER BY a.agent_name ASC, a.id ASC
